Advocate for the Respondent : Pp, Assam
 Before
 Honourable Mrs. Justice Susmita Phukan Khaund
 Order

Heard Mr. A.K. Ahmed, learned counsel for the petitioner Saidul Ali, who has filed this application under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 with prayer for pre-arrest bail a he is apprehending arrest in connection with Bongaigaon Police Station Case No. 227/2024 under Sections Page No.# 2/2 344/366/376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. Heard Mr. M.P. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the respondent State.
3.
It is submitted and admitted by the petitioner that he had a love affair with the victim and a false case has been slammed against him.
It is not possible that the victim will be continuously taken from place to place and be sexually assaulted by a person.
It is submitted that the FIR prima facie reveals that the victim is a consenting party.

sentences.text: 4. I have considered the submissions at the bar with circumspection.
5. I have considered the submission that the petitioner is willing to cooperate with the investigation.

It is also submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the incident allegedly occurred on 05.10.2023 and thereafter, it continued up-to 18.06.2024 and the FIR was lodged after a prolonged period, on 27.06.2024.
It appears that there is a prima facie case to grant interim bail to the petitioner.

6. Call for the Case Diary.
7.

In the meanwhile, in the interim and in the event of his arrest, the petitioner shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority under the condition that:
The petitioner shall not exercise threats to the witnesses.
8. List the matter on 22.08.2024.
